svg.title: Enterprise AI platform architecture
svg.desc: Product teams build AI applications on golden paths and self-service, backed by shared platform capabilities: model gateway, retrieval, prompt management, evaluation, tool registry and guardrails, on a foundation of models, enterprise data and cloud infrastructure, with identity, security, observability and governance across every layer.

text.font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: FROM INDIVIDUAL PRODUCTIVITY TO ENTERPRISE CAPABILITY

text.font-family: Manrope, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A shared AI platform, not a central bottleneck.
